recap: Nifty 50 ended at 25,144.30 (-0.61%) and the Sensex at 81,592.66 (-0.39%); Bank Nifty moved -0.79%.
By size: large caps (Nifty 100) -0.65%, mid caps (Midcap 150) -0.36%, small caps (Smallcap 250) -0.29%.
Energy led the sectors (+0.03%), while Realty lagged (-1.38%).
Top Nifty 500 gainer was Hitachi Energy India (+10.68%); biggest faller was Techno Electric (-5.91%). Breadth: 157 advances vs 341 declines.
Overseas, the S&P 500 last closed down 0.35% and the Nasdaq down 0.39%.
The rupee is at 94.25 per dollar, Brent at $95.81 (-0.01%) and gold at $3,901 (+0.40%).
